k: Agathe sits down for the first time in a year, and laughs, and cries, and presses something cold into Wren's hand.
src: 'Agathe sits down for the first time in a year, and laughs, and cries, and presses something cold into Wren\'s hand.'

k: In the upside-down tower of the Hollow Bell a girl named Agathe had been ringing for a wedding that would never come. We helped the bell be quiet.
src: 'In the upside-down tower of the Hollow Bell a girl named Agathe had been ringing for a wedding that would never come. We helped the bell be quiet.'

k: After the Sundering, white flowers began to grow on a cemetery shard. When the wind moves them, they speak.
src: 'After the Sundering, white flowers began to grow on a cemetery shard. When the wind moves them, they speak.'

k: They say the last thing someone said before they died.
src: 'They say the last thing someone said before they died.'

k: The heart is quiet. Let them grow. Let them say what they need to.
src: 'The heart is quiet. Let them grow. Let them say what they need to.'

k: Mind the beds. Everyone in them was loved by someone.
src: 'Mind the beds. Everyone in them was loved by someone.'

k: I don't plant them. They come up on their own, a flower for every last word nobody was there to hear. I only keep the paths clear.
src: 'I don\'t plant them. They come up on their own, a flower for every last word nobody was there to hear. I only keep the paths clear.'

k: At the heart there's a bloom that won't stop growing. It wants to hold every word ever spoken. It's strangling the others.
src: 'At the heart there\'s a bloom that won\'t stop growing. It wants to hold every word ever spoken. It\'s strangling the others.'

k: ...You. Lantern-girl. There's a flower in the heart that turns toward you when you walk past. I think it's been waiting.
src: '...You. Lantern-girl. There\'s a flower in the heart that turns toward you when you walk past. I think it\'s been waiting.'

k: At the heart of the garden, a single bloom the size of a house, petals overlapping like a thousand mouths, all of them whispering at once.
src: 'At the heart of the garden, a single bloom the size of a house, petals overlapping like a thousand mouths, all of them whispering at once.'

k: As the great bloom withers, the voices untangle, one by one, into silence.
src: 'As the great bloom withers, the voices untangle, one by one, into silence.'

k: One small white flower is left at the heart. It turns toward Wren.
src: 'One small white flower is left at the heart. It turns toward Wren.'

k: Tangled in the roots, where the flower grew: a locket, small and tarnished. Inside, a tiny painting of three people.
src: 'Tangled in the roots, where the flower grew: a locket, small and tarnished. Inside, a tiny painting of three people.'

k: In the Garden That Remembers, a flower said Mom's last words. I found her locket in its roots. There are three of us in the painting.
src: 'In the Garden That Remembers, a flower said Mom\'s last words. I found her locket in its roots. There are three of us in the painting.'

k: Where the Black Star hung there is only sky now — bruised, broken, and yours.
src: 'Where the Black Star hung there is only sky now — bruised, broken, and yours.'

k: Above the seven wounds, the sky goes the wrong kind of dark.
src: 'Above the seven wounds, the sky goes the wrong kind of dark.'

k: The Black Star does not shine. It takes. Light bends toward it and does not come back.
src: 'The Black Star does not shine. It takes. Light bends toward it and does not come back.'

k: The Black Star collapses into a single cold shard, small enough to hold. It hums a note below hearing.
src: 'The Black Star collapses into a single cold shard, small enough to hold. It hums a note below hearing.'

k: This scene can't be skipped
src: 'This scene can\'t be skipped'

src:
'
Arts are learned from Crest ranks; mastered Crests teach two Mastery Arts more, at their first and third Ascension stars (★).
'

src: 'Esc always cancels and opens the menu. Gamepads use the standard layout.'

k: One Crest, one life. No one you know has ever changed theirs.
src: 'One Crest, one life. No one you know has ever changed theirs.'

k: Mastery Arts — learned at Ascension stars, once mastered
src:
'
Mastery Arts — learned at Ascension stars, once mastered
'

k: Supports are passive abilities learned from Crest ranks. Any learned Support can be equipped, whatever your current Crest.
src:
'
Supports are passive abilities learned from Crest ranks. Any learned Support can be equipped, whatever your current Crest.
'

k: Move with the arrow keys or WASD; hold *Shift* to run. *Z*/*Enter* confirms and talks, *X*/*Esc* cancels, *C* opens the menu. In battle, *Q*/*E* adjusts Surge and *F* toggles Auto-battle. *T* toggles *Fast Mode*, which runs walking, cutscenes and battles at 2–4× (set the speed in Settings). *M* opens the area map (or click ⤢ on the minimap), and *R* rides Kindle once you have met the Emberhart. These are the default keys: remap any of them in *Settings → Controls* (Esc always cancels and opens the menu). Your keys are saved with your game, export included. Gamepads work too.
src: 'Move with the arrow keys or WASD; hold *Shift* to run. *Z*/*Enter* confirms and talks, *X*/*Esc* cancels, *C* opens the menu. In battle, *Q*/*E* adjusts Surge and *F* toggles Auto-battle. *T* toggles *Fast Mode*, which runs walking, cutscenes and battles at 2–4× (set the speed in Settings). *M* opens the area map (or click ⤢ on the minimap), and *R* rides Kindle once you have met the Emberhart. These are the default keys: remap any of them in *Settings → Controls* (Esc always cancels and opens the menu). Your keys are saved with your game, export included. Gamepads work too.'

k: The *Objective* in the top-left corner says what to do next, and a gold *◆* marks where: the person or place, or the exit or door that leads toward it. When it is off screen, an arrow at the edge points the way; the minimap, the area map (*M*) and the world map mark it too. Turn it off in *Settings → Quest Guide*.
src: 'The *Objective* in the top-left corner says what to do next, and a gold *◆* marks where: the person or place, or the exit or door that leads toward it. When it is off screen, an arrow at the edge points the way; the minimap, the area map (*M*) and the world map mark it too. Turn it off in *Settings → Quest Guide*.'

k: Optional quests in your *Journal* are marked in *blue*: a blue *◆* over the people and places they need on the map you are in (or over the door of the building they are in), on the minimap and area map, and floating over their stops on the world map. The Journal says where each one leads. Turn them off in *Settings → Side Quest Markers*.
src: 'Optional quests in your *Journal* are marked in *blue*: a blue *◆* over the people and places they need on the map you are in (or over the door of the building they are in), on the minimap and area map, and floating over their stops on the world map. The Journal says where each one leads. Turn them off in *Settings → Side Quest Markers*.'
